If you're joining as a member, and 35 or under, take advantage of our Young Professional Dues rate!
Simply join here prior to registering for the workshop to receive the $140 dues rate, then process your registration after.

 

When an NCURA Member purchases the Bulk Member Package of 5 or 10, registrants from their Institution receives a 10%-15% discount off the member rate whether the individuals are an NCURA member or not!

When an NCURA Non-Member purchases the Bulk Non-Member Package of 5 or 10, registrants from their Institution receive a 10%-15% discount off the Non-Member rate! (If you have an NCURA Member on your team, have them purchase the package so everyone can enjoy the NCURA Member rate!)

***Note: Only one person should register online for each bulk package needed. Example: Registration for 5 participants only requires registering one person for a bulk package - preferably a current NCURA member! Your confirmation page at the end of purchase will provide a link that will send you the bulk assignment portion of the registration.

Already registered and paid for a Bulk Package and need to assign your 5 Registration Spots?
You can do so in a few easy steps!
1. First, Log-in using your ID (your e-mail address) and password.
2. Then click on "My Dashboard" at the top of the screen.
3. Select "Assign Bulk Package Registrants" from the "Events" section.
4. Follow the steps provided within this window.

REFUND POLICY:
Refunds of the registration fee, less a $75 administrative charge, will be honored if a written request is received no later than ten business days prior to the opening day of the workshop for which you are enrolled. Please note that requests can be made online or in writing; the written request can be sent to info@ncura.edu.

BULK PACKAGE REFUND POLICY:
Full Bulk Package cancellations can be made online or in writing and must be received to the NCURA office no later than ten business days prior to the opening day of the workshop for which you are enrolled. Email, fax and telephone cancellation requests cannot be accepted. An administrative fee of $75 will be assessed for full bulk package cancellations. If a partial refund for your bulk package is requested due to a decrease in registrants from your institution, it must be received no later than ten business days prior to the opening day of the workshop. Partial refund requests for bulk packages will assess a $75 administrative fee, as well as an additional fee for any price differences from ineligibility of the special bulk rate. For example: If you purchased a bulk package for 5 registrations and request a cancellation for 1 registration included in your package, your refund amount will be deducted any additional registration fees you would have assessed if you purchased 4 individual registrations.

To cancel or modify a registration, please contact reedAMCS@ncura.edu for further instructions.

SUBSTITUTION/TRANSFER POLICY:
Participants unable to attend may transfer their registration to another individual with prior notice to NCURA. For a registration transfer, please contact reedAMCS@ncura.edu. Transfer requests are to be received prior to the start of the workshop. Sharing workshop login details is strictly prohibited.

NCURA'S COMMITMENT TO YOU:
We want to offer you: cutting-edge programs that meet your needs; know what volunteer opportunities you want; and enhance your professional network. Please take a moment to update your membership profile here.
